messages:
mike_p: AcmeEdge wants to go-live next week. Theyre sending hourly CSVs to partner S3; we prefer signed webhooks. Can we do a controlled CSV pilot? Need agreement on manifest schema, timestamp semantics (UTC epoch), signature verification, idempotency, timezone/DST, sku->billing mapping, and a smoke-test checklist.

sara_pm: Pilot ok if shadow (no billing) for 10 business days and with signed manifest (file list + HMAC). Require negative tests (duplicates, missing cols, late arrivals). Ill own acceptance criteria.

raj_eng: Engineering constraints: deterministic filenames (YYYYMMDD-HH-partner.csv), manifest.json with file list and X-Manifest-Signature (HMAC-SHA256). Row schema: partner_id, sku_id, usage_epoch_utc, quantity, unit, row_id. If row_id missing compute sha256(row) as row_id. Use epoch seconds UTC only. Example row: ACME123,EDGE-XL,1720000000,60,device-minutes,row-0001

Verification example: openssl dgst -sha256 -hmac "$PARTNER_SECRET" manifest.json | base64. If manifest missing or signature invalid, fail ingestion and alert ops.

jess_ops: Billing: need partner_sku_mapping table mapping sku_id -> billing_dimension(seats|device_minutes|requests) + required_fields. If required field missing mark row NEED_RECON and exclude from auto-invoice. Nightly recon job moves NEED_RECON to ops queue; add charge-hold toggle during pilot. Define proration rules (device-minutes round up, seats prorated by UTC day).

anna_legal: Add SOW clauses: retain raw CSV+manifests 12 months, audit logs 3 years. No plaintext PII; if required must be pseudonymized. Include audit rights and indemnity for corrupted usage causing misbilling.

mike_p: Owners: raj_eng -> ingestion spec + sample clean/dupe/corrupt files by EOD (+6h). sara_pm -> acceptance checklist & smoke-tests by tomorrow. jess_ops -> sku mapping doc + nightly recon design by day after tomorrow. anna_legal -> SOW redline by EOW.

sara_pm: Ill include tests: duplicate rows, late-arrival (48h tolerance), out-of-order timestamps, DST cutover, empty files, and provide a csv->webhook converter for partner testing.

raj_eng: Will add monitoring signals: partner.ingest.latency, partner.parse.errors/hr, partner.duplicate.rows/hr, partner.missing.manifest, and an alert threshold for parse_errors >5/hr.

jess_ops: Ill draft the nightly job and reconciliation playbook and add a Slack alert with sample rows for ops review. Also draft UI story to surface NEED_RECON counts.

deploy-bot: scheduled: partner-ingest-shadow -> tomorrow 08:00 PST (staging).

mike_p: Can everyone meet those deadlines? Planning a 30m signoff Thurs 10am to decide go/no-go and message AcmeEdge.

sara_pm: Confirmed.

raj_eng: Confirmed.

jess_ops: Confirmed.

anna_legal: Confirmed; will upload redline.

mike_p: Thanks  Ill DM AcmeEdge to delay production until pilot signoff.
